name: Air Fryer Filipino Chicken Inasal with Garlic Rice

components.name: Chicken Inasal
steps: Whisk calamansi/lime, vinegar, garlic, ginger, bruised lemongrass, sugar and salt. Marinate chicken covered in the refrigerator overnight if practical.
Discard raw-poultry-contact marinade. Warm butter with annatto in a clean saucepan; brush onto chicken during air frying using a clean brush.
Air fry in spaced batches at 190 C approximately 18-22 minutes, turning and basting, until all pieces reach 74 C.
Portion cooked chicken and garlic rice equally into five containers, cool promptly and freeze later-week portions.

components.name: Garlic Rice
steps: Cook jasmine rice with its measured water, then cool briefly. Warm neutral oil in a pan, fry the listed fresh garlic until fragrant, fold in cooked rice and salt.

Dietary: Contains dairy from annatto butter; no pork.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
